tha-ap278:1.1: Potthadāyaka.] Satthāraṃ dhammam ārabbha saṅghañ cāpi mahesino / potthadānaṃ mayā dinnaṃ {dakkhiṇeyye} anuttare. // //
tha-ap278:2.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi potthadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap278:4.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Potthadāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
